bayts.text: Truly the son of ʿAbd Allāh has surpassed all whom the Creator of time has brought forth or will bring forth.
Above all creatures He Who brought him forth chose him, as a mercy for all, after guiding him.
The faces of his noble Companions were made radiant, after his striving (in the way of Allah), which reached its end.
The abasement of whoever refused worship never ceases, and the Effacer (Al-Māḥī, Muḥammad) has effaced what sets (the false gods).
The blessing of the Chosen One is never broken, and his blazing light never fails.
His God, the Most High, willed nothing but the perfecting of his light (Qurʾān 9:32), which shone forth as adornment.
To the Chosen One I have directed a service grown pure, glad tidings for him, which has repelled my enemies.
To the Select One I have directed that which removed all that He was not pleased with for me, and (all) departed.
My Lord, through the Prophet, has demolished the edifice of harm aimed at me, and removed the peril.
The King – what an excellent King! – has made me master, (making me) a cause of shame for those given command or set upon the way.
Through my service, my God, the Helper (Al-Muʿīn), has repelled, in the measure of His Essence, my faults and the Accursed.
Truly the praise of the Select One has won for me abundant good, with (divine) good pleasure, and it has been won.
Toward others than us the Accursed has gone for ever; he does not head toward us, and he has met with anguish.
It has grieved Satan that the Select One is his master, and he meets what he feared.
The harsh (angels) shove him violently (Qurʾān 52:13) toward his abode, together with his party, and theirs is the thrusting.
His circling between the Blaze (as-Saʿīr) and the Flaming Fire (Laẓā) is the circling of one thrust toward what harms.
His pain, between scalding water and the hellish thorn (Qurʾān 88:6), is the pain of one who weeps without ceasing, struck down.
Allah has already repelled him toward others than us, decisively: and there is no god but Allah.
Toward other than what was chosen for me he creeps, and the Lord has driven him toward others than us.
Toward others than us the enemies and the envious have turned, and toward others than me every corruption heads.
An Everlasting One (Al-Bāqī) has thrown the enemies' schemes back upon the enemies, Who for my sake has already taken vengeance on whoever transgressed.
The Majesty of my Lord, the Most High, has dragged harm violently toward others than us, and it has been dragged away.
An Everlasting One guards my pens from error and oversight, Who has spared me enemies and frivolity.
He to Whom creatures and time belong has erased the harm that was heading toward me, and before that led security to me.
